title: At a local complete intersection point the conormal module is free of rank n minus the dimension
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $n\ge0$, $P=k[x_1,\dots,x_n]$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], $I\subseteq P$ an ideal, $S=P/I$ and $\mathfrak q\subset S$ a prime ideal. Assume there is $g\in S\setminus\mathfrak q$ such that the localization $S_g$ is a global complete intersection over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-complete-intersection-over-field]. Let $d=\dim_{\mathfrak q}(\operatorname{Spec}S)$ be the Krull dimension of the topological space $\operatorname{Spec}S$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] at the point $\mathfrak q$ [def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point]. Then $d$ is an integer with $0\le d\le n$, and the localization $(I/I^2)_{\mathfrak q}$ of the $S$-module $I/I^2$ at $S\setminus\mathfrak q$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization] is a free $S_{\mathfrak q}$-module [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] of rank $n-d$.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma 00SC (label lemma-lci, line 35909), implication (1) => (4), with c = height(q') - height(q) = n - dim_q(S) as in its statement (Lemma 00P2 lemma-codimension, line 28270, and dim_x A^n = n, Lemma 00OT and lemma-dim-affine-space); proof: last paragraph of the proof of 00SC (regular sequence of length t in k[y]_{q''}, J/J^2 free, Lemma 00S6 lemma-conormal-module-localize)

proof.text: Use the principal-localization prime-spectrum range theorem to obtain a prime p above q. This proves S_g nonzero, rules out the zero-ring branch of the global complete intersection definition, and yields m,t,f, t ≤ m, an algebra isomorphism e : k[y]/(f) ≃ S_g, and dim Spec(S_g)=m-t.

Reuse Algebra.dimAt_openEmbedding from Sheaf.RingTheory.SmoothAtPrimeDifferentialsDimension via a proof-only import all. This existing private theorem preserves local dimension under open embeddings. Apply it to the principal-localization open embedding and the spectrum homeomorphism of e. Transport the total dimension through e and apply global-complete-intersection-equidimensional to obtain dim_q Spec(S)=m-t.

Apply the stable conormal presentation lemma to the chosen concrete presentation: for R=S_q and N=(I/I²)_q it gives N × R^m ≃ R^(t+n). This is the regular-sequence and localized-presentation-comparison part of the original proof.

The private Lean lemma basis_of_stably_free constructs the inclusion i : N → R^(t+n) and projection s : R^(t+n) → N with s i = id. Mathlib Projective.of_split proves N projective; the surjection s proves it finite; projectivity proves flatness, and finite-flat-local-free gives freeness. The linear equivalence and Mathlib finrank_prod and finrank_pi give finrank(N)+m=t+n, without passage to a residue field. Thus m ≤ t+n; together with t ≤ m this implies m-t ≤ n and t+n-m=n-(m-t). Reindex Mathlib finBasisOfFinrankEq by this arithmetic equality and set d=m-t.

split_report.summary: Proof written in 6 steps following the last paragraph of the proof of Stacks 00SC ((1) => (4)). Statement and stmt_deps kept. Steps: (1) the prime qS_g, S_q = (S_g)_{qS_g}, and the global complete intersection presentation beta: k[y_1..y_m] -> S_g with kernel J=(f_1..f_t), dim S_g = m - t; (2) d = dim_q Spec S = m - t via the open immersion Spec S_g -> Spec S, the open-subspace lemma and the new node for equidimensionality of a global complete intersection (paragraph after 00S9; the source writes this as 't = m - dim(S_g) = height(q'') - height(q)' via 00P2); (3) f_i regular sequence in k[y]_{q''} (new node, proof of 00SB as cited in 00SC) and J/J^2 of a regular sequence free (new node, 00LN in degree 1); (4) identification of (J/J^2)_{qS_g} with JR/(JR)^2 by exactness of localization (implicit in the source); (5) Lemma 00S6 (new node) localized at q; (6) the direct summand of a finite free module over the local ring S_q is free (existing Mathlib leaves 00NZ and projective => flat), rank t + n - m = n - d, which also gives d <= n. Four new unsplit nodes, each with leansearch, leanfinder/loogle and grep recorded; none in Mathlib (Mathlib has no quasi-regular sequences, no Cohen-Macaulay rings, no comparison of conormal modules of arbitrary presentations; Algebra.Generators.cotangentCompLocalizationAwayEquiv is only 08JZ (1)).

reviewed.note: 6 steps following the last paragraph of Stacks 00SC (1)=>(4): the prime of S_g and its localization; d = m - t via the open immersion Spec S_g -> Spec S and the equidimensionality of global complete intersections (new unsplit node, Section 00S8); the f_i form a regular sequence in k[y]_{q''} (new unsplit node from the proof of 00SB) and J/J^2 is free on them (new unsplit 00LN (1) node); localization of the conormal module; the comparison (I/I^2)_g + S_g^m = J/J^2 + S_g^n (new unsplit 00S6 node); a direct summand of a finite free module over the local ring S_q is free, of rank t + n - m = n - d >= 0. L checked the two new statements on the source: all components of a global complete intersection have dimension m - t, and t elements generating an ideal of height t in a Cohen-Macaulay local ring form a regular sequence.
